inventory.notes: Two concerns. (1) spoof, input-event-birth: InputEventBirth moves a synthetic event's timeStamp back by the caller's latency and keeps births monotonic through the function-static sLastBorn (no lock; not verified that SynthesizeMouseEvent always runs on the main thread). The function is about 6 logic lines and can move to our file, leaving only the declaration in nsContentUtils.h. (2) juggler, juggler-event-id: copies mJugglerEventId onto the mouse event (B217); that line belongs to another feature and could be split out.
